      About Xenara City

      Xenara City Plug is a food spot and general shop at Executive Hostels, Mungoni, Chuka. We cook for students and neighbours: hot meals, snacks, fresh cakes and mini pizza, served from morning to late night.

      We are open 24/7 and we bring it to you. Free delivery ya kila kitu, straight to your doorstep. Best siku zote. Baked today, cooked today, enjoyed today.

      What we do

      • Meals and snacks
      • Bakery and pastry
      • Cakes and pizza
      • Fresh juices and milk
      • Ice cream and M-pops
      • Uji power and pwani pilau
      • T-shirt, hoodie and mug printing
      • Design and business branding
      • Laundry services
      • Refill perfumes
      • CCTV installation
      • Phone accessories
      • Grocery
      • Malimali and gas point
